text:
- **Pull request checks:** Each pull request now starts at most two macOS jobs, and docs-only changes skip the Go matrix. Median run time still missed the target, because macOS runners have few cores.
- **Sprint close checks:** Sprint close now checks only the covers patterns that the sprint added or changed. Another session's older pending pattern no longer blocks a sprint close.
- **AGENTS.md evaluation voting:** A part fails only on a finding a majority of its calls agree on.
- **Check wording and review:** Work started to make pm check's waiting line name the close rule. A review request for one pull request went to the owner.
